source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Language, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceGamesMarvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore EditionReleases 11/5/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/5/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCLanguage, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceLoadingThe critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch™ 2Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.OPTIMIZED FOR SWITCH 2Whether you’re playing at home or taking the galaxy with you on the go, expect smooth performance, refined controls, and seamless handheld play. TAKE THE LEADBecome Star-Lord and call the shots for the Guardians in and out of battle.ALL-NEW STORYFace a cosmic threat you unleashed in this fresh take on Guardians of the Galaxy, the winner of Best Narrative at The Game Awards 2021.BECOME FAMILYTurn your band of outlaws into legendary heroes on a wild ride across space.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)45 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Movie Strategy Guidebook My Nintendo Career Sitemap PEGI 18 Nintendo Switch Online features supported Stellar Blade™ Complete Edition System: Nintendo Switch 2 Release date: 05/11/2026 The future of humanity hangs by a thread. Earth has been devastated by mysterious, powerful creatures known as the Naytiba. With the planet lost, the last survivors of humanity fled to a Colony in outer space.EVE, member of the 7th Airborne Squad, descends from the Colony with a single mission: reclaim Earth and save humankind.But as she battles the Naytiba across the ruined remains of civilisation, uncovering fragments of the past, EVE begins to realise that her mission is far more complicated than it first appeared. The deeper she ventures into the fallen world, the more she discovers that almost nothing is as it seems. EXPERIENCE RAZOR-SHARP ACTION Engage in fast, stylish combat as you carve your way through the ruins of Earth. Master fluid attack combos, unlock powerful new abilities and weapon upgrades, and face intense boss encounters that will test both your reflexes and strategy. EXPLORE A HAUNTINGLY BEAUTIFUL WORLD Discover a stunning post-apocalyptic Earth brought to life through breathtaking science fiction environments. From desolate city ruins to mysterious landscapes, every location blends beauty and horror in unforgettable ways. UNCOVER A POWERFUL HUMAN STORY Follow EVE on a gripping journey filled with mystery, difficult choices and emotional revelations. Piece together the truth behind humanity’s fall and confront the hidden forces shaping the fate of the world.This edition also includes content from the 'Stellar Blade™ x NieR:Automata™' and 'Stellar Blade™ x GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE' DLCs.**Some included content becomes available after progressing through the main story. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 9GamesHasbro Games™ Junior CollectionReleases 11/6/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLoadingPlay Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr. Customize your avatar, unlock rewards, and enjoy local multiplayer fun for up to 4 players.Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!3 CLASSIC GAMES IN ONE: Play Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr.FUN FOR EVERYONE: Kid-friendly rules that are easy to learn and play fast.LOCAL MULTIPLAYER PARTY: Play together with up to 4 players on one console.CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR: Unlock fun new looks and cosmetic rewards as you play.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)1 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)GameShareLocalNintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
